Strategy: Shift the sweet band upward to residuals between thirty-five and fifty while keeping the mid penalty, testing whether slightly roomier leftovers work better. This steers bins toward reusable middle residuals and away from awkward small gaps, but the shifted band may match fewer real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 35 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
